description: One view on the stage, a strip of cards under it filtered by the puck; previous/next/arrow keys and the three-mounted rule kept; compare toggle splits the stage; picker per subject. Check by hand that every session view behaves as before, both themes. Design: docs/workspace-explorer.md.

title: Design review: workspace explorer proposal
description: Review docs/workspace-explorer.md; confirm or change the Decisions table and settle the Open questions, in particular the session→code join and what a unit is for markdown plans. Record decisions in the doc. Design: docs/workspace-explorer.md.

title: Models: CodeGraph, PlanGraph, Workspace, joins, shapeOf
description: src/model/code.ts, plan.ts, workspace.ts with validators for dropped files, the joins (plan→code by path; plan→session by id or title, inferred; session→code from a touches list per session built at load from events' file targets, relative paths only), and shapeOf for each subject; unit tests in Node. No UI. Design: docs/workspace-explorer.md.
close_reason: src/model/{code,plan,workspace,shape}.ts with validators, touches at load, the three joins, and shapeOf per subject; 13 unit tests. Session Shape links wait for the actor graph port (step 12).

title: Workspace explorer: code, plans, and sessions in one showcase
description: Extend Factory Clock from session views to a showcase over a whole project: code artifacts and dependencies, planning artifacts and dependencies, and sessions, with adapters per build system and planning tool, a stage-and-shelf explorer replacing the carousel, the puck as a guide with preferences, and hero views that show everything at once. Design: docs/workspace-explorer.md (proposal, 2026-11-12). Prior art: docs/workspace-explorer-prior-art.md.
notes: Sketches: docs/images/workspace-explorer-sketches.html (the page) and docs/images/sketch-*.svg (one static frame each), drawn 2026-11-12, Strata added by the owner 2026-11-13. Keep every existing view and design language; fusion of languages is explored in steps 22–23.

title: Loader: project-folder picker, file walk, adapters, Workspace in page state
description: A Choose a project folder button (input webkitdirectory) and folder drop; the walk skips .git, node_modules, build output, binaries, with named limits (2 MB/file, 20,000 files); adapters detected and switchable, with a found-summary per adapter; single files sorted by content (events, *.code.json, *.plan.json, beads JSONL export); subjects and picks in page state; the source gains listUnits, loadUnits, onWorkspace with session methods kept as aliases. Nothing leaves the browser. Design: docs/workspace-explorer.md.
